description: This Perl script is a utility for flashing firmware onto a D-Link DSL-502T router using the ADAM2 bootloader. It handles firmware verification, hardware checks, MTD configuration, and the actual flashing process, including rebooting the device afterward.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for interacting with the ADAM2 bootloader on the router, including environment variable retrieval, reboot command, and command overrides for specific ADAM2 behaviors.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to the FTP server with upper-case formatting.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the router via the FTP control connection.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables using _GETENV.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends the REBOOT command to the FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device via the FTP connection.
